name: Ship a bug fix
description: Take a bug report to a merged pull request: reproduce, fix, prove it with tests, open the PR, wait for review.

issue_url.description: Link to the bug report or issue

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the checked-out repository

base_branch.description: Branch to open the PR against (default main)

requirements.description: Working tree has no uncommitted changes
requirements.check: Run `git status --porcelain` in repo_path; ok if output is empty

requirements.description: The test suite can be executed
requirements.check: Find the test command (package.json scripts, Makefile, CI config) and run it once; ok if it starts and finishes, even with failures

credentials.why: push the fix branch and open the pull request

reproduce.title: Reproduce the bug
reproduce.instructions: Read the issue. Write a failing test, or find a command, that demonstrates the bug on the current code. Do not change production code yet.

repro.description: Test name or command that fails because of the bug

summary.description: One sentence: what is wrong and where

reproduced.description: You have a failing test or command that shows the bug

cannot_reproduce.description: The report is not enough to reproduce it

fix.title: Write the fix
fix.instructions: Make the smallest change that fixes the cause, not the symptom. Keep the reproduction test. Commit on a branch named fix/<short-slug>.

verify.title: Run the full test suite
verify.instructions: Run the whole suite, not just the new test. Report the exact command and result.

failing.description: Names of failing tests, if any

fail.description: Something fails; go back and fix.

open_pr.title: Open the pull request
open_pr.instructions: Push the branch and open a PR against base_branch (default main): `machine run <run_id> -- git push -u origin <branch>` then `machine run <run_id> -- gh pr create --fill` (the github slot is live only here). Body: what was wrong, what changed, how it was verified, link to issue_url.

changes_requested.description: Reviewer wants changes; the comment thread says what

needs_info.title: Need more information from the reporter
